summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Manager Dashboard for Project Management module. All features working correctly: API returns all required data, dashboard page loads at /projects/manager, all stats cards display correctly, donut charts render, bar chart shows weekly completion, team workload section shows members, at-risk/deadlines sections show appropriate messages, refresh button reloads data, All Projects button navigates correctly, sidebar navigation works between Manager Dashboard, My Tasks, and All Projects.

manager_dashboard_api_endpoint.details: GET /api/projects/manager-dashboard returns 200 with all required data: project stats, task stats, breakdowns, team workload, at-risk projects, upcoming deadlines, recent activity, weekly completion

dashboard_page_loads.details: Manager Dashboard loads correctly at /projects/manager route with data-testid='manager-dashboard-page'

project_stats_cards.details: All 5 project stat cards visible: Total Projects (2), Active (0), Completed (0), On Hold (0), At Risk (0)

task_stats_cards.details: All 5 task stat cards visible: Total Tasks (4), Completed (1, 25% done), Overdue (1), Unassigned (1), Blocked (1)

projects_by_status_donut.details: Donut chart renders correctly showing 2 Draft projects with legend

projects_by_priority_donut.details: Donut chart renders correctly showing 2 High priority projects with legend

weekly_task_completion_chart.details: Bar chart shows 7 days (Tue-Mon) with 1 task completed on Monday

team_workload_section.details: Shows 2 team members (Super Administrator, Test User 132857) with task counts and progress bars

at_risk_projects_section.details: Shows 'All projects on track!' message when no at-risk projects exist

upcoming_deadlines_section.details: Section visible and shows 'No upcoming deadlines this week' message appropriately

recent_activity_timeline.details: Recent Activity section visible showing latest project/task actions

refresh_button.details: Refresh button (data-testid='refresh-dashboard-btn') reloads dashboard data successfully

all_projects_button.details: All Projects button (data-testid='view-all-projects-btn') navigates to /projects page

sidebar_manager_dashboard_link.details: Manager Dashboard link visible under Project Management section and highlighted when active

sidebar_navigation.details: Navigation between Manager Dashboard, My Tasks, and All Projects works correctly via sidebar

critical_code_review_comments: Code is well-structured with all required data-testid attributes for testing
Dashboard correctly aggregates data from pm_projects, pm_tasks, pm_activity_logs collections
Cream/beige color scheme consistent with other PM pages (#4A3728, #5D4A3A, #E8D5C4)
Donut charts and bar charts render correctly with responsive design
Team workload shows progress bars with completion percentages
At-risk detection logic correctly identifies projects with overdue tasks or past deadlines
